ADX 24.4로 추세 형성 초기 단계, -DI(32.5)가 +DI(18.3) 상회하며 하락 우위 지속.
keyPointsEn: RSI at 36.3, entering oversold territory, continuing its decline from 48.1 five days ago.
MACD histogram at -26.7549, worsening and reinforcing a downtrend from 52.4212 five days ago.
